context.quote: For many years, Season 2 was the only season where all fights that took place were considered as professional MMA bouts by the Nevada State Athletic Commission.  However, this has recently been changed and they are now considered to be exhibition bouts.
context.note: secondary; cites the same NSAC document. Records that the commission's treatment changed at some point, so an older record or third-party database may still show these as professional bouts. The current commission document is the authority; the change is worth recording.

sources.quote: Eighteen of the world's toughest heavyweights and welterweights compete for two UFC contracts.
with 9 fighters initially in each division

actual.pre_draft_episode_1: Before the draft: heavyweight Kerry Schall out with a knee injury; Eli Joslin left the show; Kenny Stevens, chosen as the weakest welterweight, called out Sammy Morgan and forfeited, saying he could not make weight. Sixteen were drafted.
actual.draft: Episode 2: a coin flip gave Franklin the first pick; each coach picked 8 (4 per division). Dan Christison joined as Schall's replacement.
actual.matchups: Team challenges (designed and hosted by Randy Couture) decided which team chose the next elimination matchup; the loser of each house fight left.
actual.replacement: Josh Burkman won the first fight but broke his arm and left (episode 3); Jason Von Flue replaced him and fought his way into the semi-finals.
advanced_without_house_fight: Sammy Morgan (opponent forfeited before the draft)
team_moves: Jason Von Flue to Team Franklin (episode 7)
actual.semi_finals: Set by Dana White, Franklin and Hughes with fighter input (episode 10). Marcus Davis was brought back as alternate for a cut Von Flue, who was then cleared. Semi-finals fought 07/11/05 and 07/12/05 per the commission record.
actual.fight_dates: The commission record dates all 12 house bouts: 2005-06-15 to 2005-07-12. They are fight dates, distinct from air dates (August to November 2005).
actual.declared_format_proposal: elimination_then_semifinals, with a pre-draft selection phase (episode 1) recorded as timeline events rather than bouts; the forfeit is not a bout and must not be invented as one
actual.joslin_division: not stated by any captured source; left unassigned rather than guessed
